name: Mishima Youko
source: [url=/c59135]Kazuma's[/url] maid, who replaced his real mother and raised him as her own child. She's not good at cooking and cleaning, but good at fighting. Believes that one day [url=/c59135]Kazuma[/url] will make her his wife.
